note: Same drive as v1. Modules screw onto two heat-set inserts in each carriage top. Lengths from the model: holder screws pass the 3 mm cap and grip 5 mm of the 6 mm insert hole; cam-plate screws sit in a 2 mm counterbore and pass 7.3 mm of plate + standoff (4.7 mm into the insert); bracket screws pass the 4.05 mm bracket block and the 4 mm base into an M3 nut in a pocket under the base (about 2.3 mm of thread, NEEDS CHECK). Only the module you use needs its screws.

lines.where: lead screw: head pressed into the knob, through the end wall and jaw A
inside the end wall: holds the screw axially; snug, not tight, so it still turns
jaw A nut trap (drop in from the top)
carriage tops, 2 per carriage: module mount (melt in with a soldering iron)
items: M3 heat-set insert, 4 mm long, OD ≈ 4.5 mm (NEEDS CHECK against the Ø4.0 × 6 mm hole)

lines.where: parallel module: holder to carriage (2 per holder)
pull module: cam plate to carriage (2 per plate)
pull module: bracket to base through its slots (2 per bracket)
items: M3 hex nut (ISO 4032), in the pocket under the base
